claims.statement: For any restriction law dominated by ratio R, E U >= (R-2) E I/2 - E(RI-H)/2 + E Var + E b/2. For c_n-maximizers under t-random physical restrictions this is at least [((c_n-2)t)/2-(1-t)/ln2] I(f) plus the retained terminal terms.
claims.scope: Genuine Boolean functions and genuine physical restrictions; bits; endpoint convention 0 log(1/0)=0.
claims.remaining_obstacle: No dimension-independent upper bound on U/I follows; an independent asymmetry, pivotal-height, or GU' payment is still required.
